'''Dagobah Smallpox''' was a disease that could be contracted by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and other species. While working at the security scanner at the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency, [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[G2-4T]] claimed his scanner detected that a number of passengers contracted the disease, though he added that they should not worry, since droids were immune.
